Message:
A sinister black presence
envelops the ruined Church.
Lady Elfriede is somewhere
within it...

But, the second I take
one small step towards it,
I feel a shiver
run down my spine...
Just what is happening
in there?

Then suddenly...
the black key begins
to shine, driving back
the sinister presence...

“You have my gratitude, Illya.”
...In one burst of speed,
I sprint forward,
then fling the Church’s
doors wide open.

That inhuman smile.
That gaze of disdain...
There’s no mistake about it!

Before me stands the source
of all the pain that has
tormented Lady Elfriede
to this very day...!
Once again, I failed to save...

No, I can still do it!
This time, I will save you!
And if this is what it takes...

“I believe you
told me once before.
That you would watch as I die.
Very well—I shall make
good on that promise.

I’ll give you my life.
And in return,
you will set Lady Elfriede free!”

“I merely whispered
those words in jest.
Hardly enough to
form a contract...

But, I am in
a rather pleasant mood.
Playing with you until
everything is done might
prove to be...entertaining...”
